raw_segments.text: but sometimes the sovereign authority is composed of preorganized political bodies
by virtue of circumstances interior to their union.
And in this case, the provincial governments assume the control,
not only of those affairs which more peculiarly belong to their province,
but of all or of a part of the mixed affairs to which illusion has been made.
For the Confederate nations which were independent sovereign states before their union
and which still represent a very considerable share of the sovereign power,
have only consented to cede to the general government
the exercise of those rights which are indispensable to the union.
